■ Neo Evolution: You may put it on one of your light, water or nature creatures. (If a card is under it, treat it as a Neo Evolution Creature.)
Justdiver

■ When you put this creature or it attacks, draw a card. Then you may put a Snow Faerie that costs 4 or less from your hand or mana zone.
